title: Patchwork Saint
pitch: Your armor is a quilt of the dead's memories - where you sew each patch decides which gifts synergize and which curses stay sealed.
howto: Sew fabric patches onto your golem's 4x4 quilt body; adjacent memories weave named synergies and 2 right-tagged neighbors quarantine a cursed patch. March on pilgrimage: an auto-battle arena where your quilt's stats fight for you. Grind thread to scavenge new patches and upgrade your needle for more quilt slots and rarer finds.
controls: Tap a patch, then tap a cell to sew. In battle: tap the field to throw needles, tap PATCH SURGE for a synergy-powered blast.
